tourIdeas.title: Tour Ideas in Madagascar
tourIdeas.subtitle: Madagascar, a land of natural wonders and cultural treasures, invites you to imagine your own adventure.
tourIdeas.intro: With varied landscapes, distinctive wildlife and a rich culture, the island offers many ways to travel. These circuits give you a glimpse of what is possible and inspiration for an itinerary shaped around your interests. I would be happy to help you choose suitable stops and a comfortable pace.
tourIdeas.metaDescription: Explore Madagascar tour ideas: the RN7, Tsingy, baobabs, national parks, the East Coast and Nosy Be with a local driver-guide.
tourIdeas.faqTitle: Questions about choosing a Madagascar tour

faqs.question: What tours can I take in Madagascar?
faqs.answer: Ideas include the RN7 and the South, the Tsingy and baobabs, eastern parks, the North and Nosy Be, and trips in the Central Highlands.

faqs.question: How do I choose an itinerary for my trip?
faqs.answer: Consider your travel time, preferred regions, season and road conditions. A local driver-guide can help discuss the route and stops.

faqs.question: Can the suggested tours be customised?
faqs.answer: Yes. Suggestions are a starting point; stops and pace can be adapted and confirmed according to local availability and conditions.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.cookieDescription: A cookie is a small text file stored on your device (computer, tablet or smartphone) when you visit a website. It helps remember user settings, make browsing easier and enable certain features.
cookiePolicy.necessaryDescription: These are essential for the website to work (for example, to remember your language choice or your session if you are an administrator). They do not require your consent.
cookiePolicy.thirdPartyDescription: If you consent, we load a Trustindex widget to display reviews from our Tripadvisor page. This service may use cookies to measure audience activity or personalise its display. These cookies require your prior consent.
cookiePolicy.manageChoices: How can I manage my choices?
cookiePolicy.manageChoicesDescription: On your first visit, a banner lets you accept or reject these cookies. You can change your choice at any time by clearing your browser cookies or using its privacy settings.
